连接 → 选择工具 → 跟踪 → 导入影像 → 点配准 → 影像空间显示: Connect → Select tools → Track → Import image → Register → Image-space display
采集当前 SDK 针尖为实物点: Collect SDK tip in Reference frame
未配准；两组点按列表顺序一一对应: Unregistered; pair landmarks in list order
未录制；10 帧/秒，编码积压时丢弃录制帧: Idle; 10 fps; drop capture frames when encoder queue is full
CAD 名义针尖：未实物标定。球心匹配 RMS 不等于针尖标定误差。: CAD tip is nominal. Marker fit RMS is not tip calibration error.
导入工具网格（STL / OBJ / PLY / VTK）: Import tool mesh (STL / OBJ / PLY / VTK)
导入不等于标定或配准。网格初始为独立预览；绑定需要以 mm 为单位的已知刚体矩阵: Import does not register data. Attachment requires a known rigid transform in mm; image objects are not optical references.
显示该工具球心（非完整 CAD；使用上方绑定对象）: Show calibrated marker centers (not full CAD)
针尖来源见坐标快照；CAD 名义值尚未实物标定。READY 仅代表双工具跟踪有效: See coordinates for tip source. CAD tip is nominal; READY only indicates valid dual tracking.
多选 STP 并逐件选择配套 aimtool: Select STP files and pair each with aimtool
全匹配为默认；三球仅实验预览。两球不解算有效位姿。: Full matching by default; three markers: experimental preview; two markers: no unique pose.
按当前 Tool / 参考工具 同时显示模型: Show selected Tool and Reference models
短暂丢失保留 0.25 秒原色模型（历史位置）: Hold last model for 0.25 seconds (historical pose)
告警时保持模型与实时诊断坐标: Keep models and live diagnostics during alarms
模型保持原色；数据质量单独标注。未配准的影像不会随器械移动。: Preserve model colors; label quality separately. Unregistered images do not follow tools.
将导入模型挂载到光学工具（默认不挂载）: Attach imported model to optical tool (off by default)
绑定对象使用上方“模型绑定对象”；挂载需要实际标定或配准矩阵。: Use the attachment target above and a measured calibration / registration matrix.
按当前 导航工具／参考工具 同时显示模型: Show current navigation and reference models
